title: BCJGF JBE CAIF CBBCBCBIBFBFBD
about: The memories of Ballroom Year beyond the romance: the stage, the people, the music, the places, and even an unexpected encounter with my own family history at the fair.
body: BCJGF JBE CAIF CBBCBCBIBFBFBD is the other side of my Ballroom Year. While another album tells the story of my relationship with Alyssa, this one holds the rest of the memories that made that State Arts-In year important to me.

These songs preserve the pieces that stayed with me: performing with Lanny, my 4-H father; John leading us through a familiar warm-up; constantly moving between the ballroom floor, staircase, balcony, and other staging zones; and a yellow costume vest that looked very different after a week of performances than it did when we started.

But not every important memory happened onstage. In the Agriculture Building, I came across an exhibit connected to my great-grandfather's vineyards. Something that had once been a real place and part of my family's history had been reduced to a single photograph hanging at the fair. It turned an ordinary walk through an exhibit building into something much more personal.

Years later, hearing Shadows of Night unexpectedly brought the ballroom, the stage, and memories I had nearly forgotten rushing back. Eventually the set came down and the stage emptied like it always does, but Ballroom Year left behind far more than the production itself. This album is about all those other pieces that made that year mine.
